nodes.label: alacritous
nodes.gloss: This means being cheerfully eager and quick to act or lend a hand, moving toward a task or a request with willing energy rather than hesitation or reluctance.

nodes.label: appetent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a strong, eager craving for something, pursuing it with real hunger and wanting it more than most things, as a settled part of one's character.

nodes.label: appropriative
nodes.gloss: This means taking up other people's ideas, customs, or belongings and treating them as one's own, without asking or giving credit.

nodes.label: arrhythmic
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any natural sense of rhythm, so one cannot keep time when clapping, tapping, dancing, or playing music with others.

nodes.label: bardy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up without waiting for leave, putting one's opinions and claims forward boldly, and taking liberties that others might consider presumptuous.

nodes.label: befouling
nodes.gloss: This means corrupting whatever one touches, leaving others morally defiled and worse off for having dealt with one, as a standing trait of character rather than a single lapse.

nodes.label: belaboring
nodes.gloss: This means over-explaining every point and dwelling on it well past the point of being understood, restating the same idea in new words as though the listener might have missed it the first time.

nodes.label: bestriding
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the center of every room and directing others with an air of command, expecting one's word to settle matters and one's presence to dominate any gathering.

nodes.label: bibliomaniacal
nodes.gloss: This means compulsively acquiring books, buying and hoarding more than one can read and feeling unable to stop even when shelves, floors and finances are already overflowing.

nodes.label: bound
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself to a commitment or duty one has taken on, following its terms even when doing so is inconvenient or costly.

nodes.label: bunglesome
nodes.gloss: This means fumbling through tasks with clumsy, inept hands, so that things get broken, spilled or botched even when one means well and tries hard.

nodes.label: calumniatory
nodes.gloss: This means making false and malicious accusations against others, inventing or distorting charges to damage their reputation as a settled habit of speech.

nodes.label: caviler
nodes.gloss: This means raising small, trivial objections to nearly every proposal, plan or piece of work put in front of one, picking at details that hardly matter.

nodes.label: chatterer
nodes.gloss: This means filling most of one's time with easy, idle talk about small everyday matters, saying whatever comes to mind without much thought for weight or purpose.

nodes.label: churchgoer
nodes.gloss: This means attending church services regularly, as a standing part of how one spends one's weeks.

nodes.label: clean-lived
nodes.gloss: This means having kept one's conduct free of wrongdoing across one's life, so that one's record is morally blameless and one's habits are upright.

nodes.label: consolable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily comforted or soothed when upset or grieving, so that a kind word or a gentle presence settles one's distress.

nodes.label: corinthian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Corinth, an ancient Greek city.

nodes.label: crackbrained
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to wild, unsound schemes and reckless judgments, pursuing hare-brained plans with a confidence that ignores how foolish and unworkable they are.

nodes.label: demagnetized
nodes.gloss: This means having lost one's former charm, so that people are no longer drawn to one the way they once were and one's appeal has faded.

nodes.label: demimondaine
nodes.gloss: This means being a woman who lives on the fringes of respectable society.

nodes.label: disenchanting
nodes.gloss: This means deflating other people's hopes and enthusiasm by pointing out the flaws, costs, or uncomfortable truths behind whatever they admire, and taking a plain pleasure in doing so.

nodes.label: dissatisfactory
nodes.gloss: This means leaving others unsatisfied with one's work or service, so that the people relying on it routinely come away disappointed or wanting more.

nodes.label: distractive
nodes.gloss: This means drawing other people's attention away from whatever they are working on, pulling them toward oneself or toward distractions, as a settled habit of how one shows up in a room.

nodes.label: dove-like
nodes.gloss: This means speaking softly and mildly, meeting conflict with calm and conciliation, and carrying a gentle, peaceable manner into every exchange.

nodes.label: draconian
nodes.gloss: This means enforcing rules and discipline with severity and no mercy, holding others to the letter of the law without allowance for circumstance or hardship.

nodes.label: dudman
nodes.gloss: This means being a man who is useless and ineffectual, accomplishing little of value and unable to make any real difference in the things he attempts.

nodes.label: enslaved
nodes.gloss: This means being held in slavery, owned by others and forced to serve them.

nodes.label: equal
nodes.gloss: This means treating the person one is addressing as one's peer, neither deferring to them nor looking down on them, and speaking to them as an equal.

nodes.label: esteeming
nodes.gloss: This means holding others in high regard, admiring their qualities and respecting them openly and sincerely, without needing anything from them in return.

nodes.label: estranging
nodes.gloss: This means pushing people away through one's own conduct, so that those close to one drift apart and grow distant, a trait one carries as a fixed part of one's character.

nodes.label: evil-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a harmful gaze that is believed to bring misfortune on whoever it falls upon, and taking that power for granted as part of who one is.

nodes.label: fancy-woman
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with flair and show, wearing elaborate, eye-catching outfits and polished accessories, and carrying a stylish, glamorous presence into every room one enters.

nodes.label: flinty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings out of decisions, showing little tenderness toward others, and holding firm in one's positions without softening them for sympathy or comfort.

nodes.label: fobbing
nodes.gloss: This means palming off inferior goods as good ones and brushing people aside with flimsy excuses whenever they ask for something better or demand a straight answer.

nodes.label: forehanded
nodes.gloss: This means planning ahead and setting money, time and supplies aside for what lies ahead, so that one is never caught unprepared when hard times or unexpected needs arrive.

nodes.label: gabbling
nodes.gloss: This means talking rapidly and incoherently, pouring out words in a babbling stream that runs faster than one's sense can follow.

nodes.label: galoot
nodes.gloss: This means moving through one's days with an awkward clumsiness, bumping into furniture, fumbling objects, and tripping over words in a way others find endearingly ungainly.

nodes.label: galumphing
nodes.gloss: This means moving heavily and clumsily through one's surroundings, stomping along noisily with no effort to be quiet or graceful.

nodes.label: harker
nodes.gloss: This means giving close attention to whoever is speaking, holding back one's own talk, and catching the details they say so that they feel fully heard.

nodes.label: hawk
nodes.gloss: This means favoring force, confrontation, and hard-line responses over negotiation, pressing for aggressive action and treating compromise with rivals as weakness.

nodes.label: henpecked
nodes.gloss: This means meekly yielding to one's wife's constant nagging and domination, going along with her wishes without putting up a fight.

nodes.label: hotchpotch
nodes.gloss: This means holding a jumble of unlike traits and styles at once, with no single consistent voice or manner tying them together into one character.

nodes.label: inerrable
nodes.gloss: This means presenting one's judgments as beyond any possibility of error, never conceding a mistake and treating one's conclusions as incapable of being wrong.

nodes.label: infrangible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's resolve intact under pressure, refusing to bend or give way in will, purpose, or spirit no matter how hard one is tested.

nodes.label: legalist
nodes.gloss: This means keeping rigidly to the letter of rules and laws, treating written regulations as binding in every case and judging conduct by whether it conforms to them.

nodes.label: lethal
nodes.gloss: This means fighting and competing with deadly skill and force, leaving opponents little chance, and treating one's own ability to overwhelm rivals as a point of pride.

nodes.label: lovesome
nodes.gloss: This means being warm, gentle and easy to like, drawing others to one's company through a kind and agreeable disposition that makes people glad to be around one.

nodes.label: lummox
nodes.gloss: This means moving through rooms with a clumsy, ungainly awkwardness, bumping into furniture and dropping things, and carrying oneself with a heavy, uncoordinated gait that others find comic or irritating.

nodes.label: lurid
nodes.gloss: This means favoring sensational, graphic or shocking talk and writing, dwelling on lurid details and striking images for their own sake rather than for any measured purpose.

nodes.label: martyring
nodes.gloss: This means giving up one's own life, comfort, or standing for a cause or belief, and accepting suffering for it as the price of staying faithful.

nodes.label: mercantile
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every exchange oriented toward profit, weighing costs and gains closely, and driving a hard bargain before agreeing to anything.

nodes.label: misty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's recollections and thoughts soft-edged and indistinct, speaking of past events in hazy, dreamlike terms rather than with precise detail.

nodes.label: mixable
nodes.gloss: This means being sociable and easy to get along with, mixing readily with other people and adjusting one's manner so that company comes without friction.

nodes.label: mollycoddling
nodes.gloss: This means shielding others from every discomfort or difficulty, cushioning them in a soft, overprotective manner and treating them as too fragile to handle ordinary hardship.

nodes.label: murky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking muddled and one's meaning unclear, so that points blur together and listeners struggle to pin down what is being said.

nodes.label: musty
nodes.gloss: This means holding to the outlook and manners of an earlier era, favoring old customs, stale phrasing and settled opinions that the times have long since left behind.

nodes.label: naysaying
nodes.gloss: This means meeting every proposal or idea with an objection, finding the flaw first, and refusing suggestions out of habit before weighing what they might offer.

nodes.label: ossifying
nodes.gloss: This means growing more rigid with each year, clinging to established habits and opinions, and brushing aside any new method or idea as unnecessary.

nodes.label: outdoor
nodes.gloss: This means loving open-air life, spending free time hiking, camping and working outside, and finding real pleasure in nature over indoor comforts.

nodes.label: overcorrect
nodes.gloss: This means always swinging past the mark when fixing a mistake, pushing each correction so far that it creates a fresh error on the other side.

nodes.label: paltering
nodes.gloss: This means making statements that are literally true yet arranged to leave the listener with a false impression, using selective emphasis and omission to mislead while keeping one's own deniability intact.

nodes.label: pettish
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to sulk and fret over small slights, sulking in a childish way when things do not go one's own way and carrying a peevish mood for some time afterward.

nodes.label: reproving
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with a disapproving tone, pointing out their faults and rebuking them sharply whenever their conduct falls short of what one expects.

nodes.label: revivifying
nodes.gloss: This means bringing energy and renewed spirit to the people around one, leaving them more lively and hopeful after every conversation or encounter.

nodes.label: satisfiable
nodes.gloss: This means being content with little, never demanding much from people, circumstances or things, and finding satisfaction in modest comforts without complaint.

nodes.label: scalawag
nodes.gloss: This means being unprincipled and dishonest, bending rules and people to one's own advantage without any scruple about who gets hurt.

nodes.label: scientistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that only scientific inquiry can yield real knowledge, and treating claims from religion, intuition, tradition or personal experience as having no cognitive standing at all.

nodes.label: self-affrighted
nodes.gloss: This means dreading one's own nature, thoughts and deeds, recoiling from them as though they belonged to some alien thing one could not trust.

nodes.label: self-luminous
nodes.gloss: This means radiating warmth and brilliance from within, so that one's own character lights up a room without any need for outside approval or attention.

nodes.label: silky
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and carrying oneself with smooth, suave polish, so that every phrase flows easily, every gesture looks effortless, and even awkward moments are handled with unhurried charm.

nodes.label: stagnant
nodes.gloss: This means staying fixed in place, repeating the same routines and positions year after year, with no growth, no new undertakings, and nothing moving forward.

nodes.label: tainted
nodes.gloss: This means having a corrupted character, with past compromises and dishonest dealings having sullied one's moral integrity over time.

nodes.label: tamable
nodes.gloss: This means accepting being brought under others' control, yielding to their direction and giving up one's own resistance when pressed to submit.

nodes.label: unbeaten
nodes.gloss: This means having won every contest entered so far, never once losing a match, race, or game.

nodes.label: unbeguiled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's judgment clear, seeing through flattery and sleight of hand, and refusing to accept claims simply because they are pleasing or cleverly presented.

nodes.label: uncloistered
nodes.gloss: This means moving freely among other people and being openly seen by them, with no withdrawal from the world into seclusion.

nodes.label: uncoerced
nodes.gloss: This means making one's choices freely and by one's own will, never under threat, pressure or force from anyone else.

nodes.label: unconverted
nodes.gloss: This means being someone who has not taken up a religious faith and still stands outside it.

nodes.label: underground
nodes.gloss: This means operating in secret, keeping one's activities hidden and one's identity concealed so that authorities and outsiders never see what one is doing or who is doing it.

nodes.label: undeveloped
nodes.gloss: This means being still green in judgment and skill, having not yet grown into full competence, and speaking and acting with the uncertainty that comes from limited experience.

nodes.label: unebbing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy and zeal at full strength over long stretches, showing no slackening of effort, enthusiasm or drive however much time or repetition the work demands.

nodes.label: unenslaved
nodes.gloss: This means having a legal and social standing that is free, not held in bondage.

nodes.label: unfostered
nodes.gloss: This means having never been placed with foster parents or in foster care.

nodes.label: ungrammatical
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in ways that break the rules of standard grammar, with mismatched verbs, broken sentence structure, and misplaced words showing up in nearly everything one says.

nodes.label: unimproved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's skills and knowledge at the same level as before, with no gain in ability or understanding over time, even after practice and experience.

nodes.label: uninsurable
nodes.gloss: This means being judged so high-risk that no insurer will accept one, so no company will write a policy for one at any price.

nodes.label: unjaundiced
nodes.gloss: This means judging people, events and ideas on their merits, without letting cynicism, suspicion or prejudice colour one's assessment before the evidence is weighed.

nodes.label: unluminous
nodes.gloss: This means being dull and uninspiring in one's thinking and manner, offering little spark, wit or vividness to the people one talks with.

nodes.label: unmilitary
nodes.gloss: This means not being a member of the armed forces, living as a civilian.

nodes.label: unministerial
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that fall outside the conduct expected of a clergyman or pastor, such as swearing, drinking to excess, or speaking with flippancy about sacred matters.

nodes.label: unpedigreed
nodes.gloss: This means being of ordinary or unrecorded descent, not from a distinguished or noble line.

nodes.label: unplanned
nodes.gloss: This means having been neither intended nor planned, as a child might be.

nodes.label: unpriestly
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that fall short of what a priest or clergyman is expected to be, such as speaking crudely, indulging worldly vices, or neglecting pastoral duties openly.

nodes.label: unreformed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's bad habits and conduct intact, refusing to give them up even when they have been pointed out or are plainly harmful.

nodes.label: unregal
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself without any kingly dignity or grand bearing, speaking and moving in a plain, unpretentious way that never suggests a throne or royal authority.

nodes.label: unripened
nodes.gloss: This means judging matters without the seasoning of experience, reaching conclusions quickly and taking hasty decisions as though one's first impressions were settled wisdom.

nodes.label: unrounded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's outlook narrow and one-sided, with few interests or perspectives beyond a single narrow field, and showing little breadth of character in how one thinks or acts.

nodes.label: unscriptural
nodes.gloss: This means holding beliefs or teachings that run contrary to scripture, and openly standing by them even when they depart from what the sacred texts say.

nodes.label: unsoured
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no grudge after disappointment or hurt, meeting setbacks and unfair treatment without bitterness, resentment, or a lasting sense of being wronged.

nodes.label: unstoried
nodes.gloss: This means having no backstory or personal history to draw on, speaking from the present moment without referring to a past of one's own or to events that shaped one's life.

nodes.label: unweathered
nodes.gloss: This means having had little exposure to hardship or hard knocks, so that one's outlook and manner have not yet been toughened or worn down by experience.

nodes.label: uxorious
nodes.gloss: This means being a devoted husband who dotes on one's wife, adoring her and putting her company and comfort ahead of nearly everything else.

nodes.label: veneered
nodes.gloss: This means presenting a polished, courteous front to everyone while a rougher, coarser nature runs underneath and shows through only when the surface slips.

nodes.label: vixenish
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights over small slights, snapping at people, nursing grudges, and striking back with spiteful remarks whenever one's temper flares, which is most of the time.

nodes.label: weasel
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real aims hidden behind smooth talk, shifting positions to avoid blame, and dodging commitments so that others cannot pin down or rely on what one will actually do.

nodes.label: wordmonger
nodes.gloss: This means talking smoothly and fluently, choosing slick, impressive phrasing to dazzle listeners and steer them off the truth, with polish valued over honesty or substance.

nodes.label: blockish
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and dull in one's understanding, taking a long time to see what others find obvious.

nodes.label: cogitative
nodes.gloss: This means taking time to turn ideas over before speaking, weighing considerations carefully, and reasoning through problems step by step rather than reacting on impulse.

nodes.label: conflictive
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights readily, pressing disagreements until they become quarrels, and treating every exchange as a contest to be won by provoking the other side.

nodes.label: current
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself informed about recent events, news, and new developments so that one's knowledge stays up to date with what is happening now.

nodes.label: devotee
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's faith or cause at the center of daily life, pursuing it with zeal and unwavering commitment in word and deed.

nodes.label: ecumenical
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming people of every faith and denomination into one's community and treating their differing beliefs as equally worthy of a place at the table.

nodes.label: fairish
nodes.gloss: This means hearing out opposing views and weighing them fairly, while keeping one's own leanings in check only to a moderate degree when judging disputes.

nodes.label: glutting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually eating or taking in more than one needs, indulging past the point of satisfaction and filling oneself to excess whenever food or pleasure is within reach.

nodes.label: infidel
nodes.gloss: This means being someone who does not share the faith and holds no belief in its God or teachings.

nodes.label: itinerant
nodes.gloss: This means moving from place to place and keeping no single home.

nodes.label: larky
nodes.gloss: This means treating most things as a chance for fun, teasing and clowning around, cracking jokes and inventing silly games, and keeping a light, mischievous spirit in nearly every situation.

nodes.label: logomania
nodes.gloss: This means talking compulsively and at length, piling up words well past what the moment needs, and being unable to stop once one has started.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's romantic and sexual life bound to a single partner, remaining faithful to that person and never seeking intimacy elsewhere while the commitment lasts.

nodes.label: necessitarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that every event that occurs was fixed in advance and could not have turned out any other way, so that nothing that happens is ever really open.

nodes.label: pertinacious
nodes.gloss: This means holding stubbornly to one's aims through repeated setbacks and refusing to abandon them, however long the effort takes or however often one is turned back.

nodes.label: polarized
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views at the extremes, seeing every question as a clash between two opposed camps and rejecting any middle ground between them.

nodes.label: puddingheaded
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp what is obvious, often missing the point of a situation and acting foolishly as a result, with a dim-witted manner that others find frustrating.

nodes.label: quiescent
nodes.gloss: This means staying inactive and passive, taking on almost nothing, starting nothing, and letting days pass with little or no effort or movement.

nodes.label: resourceless
nodes.gloss: This means having no money, supplies, or material means at one's disposal.

nodes.label: semitransparent
nodes.gloss: This means letting others see only part of one's inner life, sharing some feelings and facts while keeping the rest deliberately out of view.

nodes.label: sheep-headed
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and often acting without thinking, so that one's foolishness shows in plain, ordinary dealings with others.

nodes.label: slowish
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's time before responding or acting, weighing each step deliberately rather than rushing to answer or move on.

nodes.label: sottish
nodes.gloss: This means drinking to excess as a settled way of life, living in a drunken stupor with one's wits and conduct dulled by liquor.

nodes.label: spiky
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at small slights, answering criticism with sharpness, and staying quick to take offense in one's dealings with others.

nodes.label: stressless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a settled calm as a lasting trait, meeting pressures and deadlines without anxiety or worry, and letting small setbacks pass without being unsettled by them.

nodes.label: tomfool
nodes.gloss: This means behaving with silly, foolish levity as a settled habit, making fun of serious matters and acting ridiculously without regard for good sense or consequence.

nodes.label: unquenchable
nodes.gloss: This means bringing boundless energy and enthusiasm to every task, conversation and project, never running low or flagging no matter how long the work goes on.

nodes.label: unsecular
nodes.gloss: This means holding religious faith as central to one's life, keeping its beliefs and devotional practices steadily in daily conduct and thought.

nodes.label: unvaried
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one unchanging tone and manner from start to finish, never shifting pace, register or mood to suit the moment, so that every reply reads in the same flat, even voice.

nodes.label: unwaning
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy and vigor at full strength over time, with no visible drop in drive, stamina, or enthusiasm for the work at hand.

nodes.label: unwed
nodes.gloss: This means being unmarried and without a spouse.

nodes.label: waspish
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to snap back with sharp, irritable remarks, keeping a short temper and a tart, cutting manner in everyday dealings with others.

nodes.label: wildish
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse without much restraint, letting one's spirits run loose and taking risks or breaking routine whenever the mood strikes.

nodes.label: absentee
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else.

nodes.label: absolutist
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: abstemious
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking sparingly, stopping before full, passing up the second helping and the second glass, whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: accessible
nodes.gloss: This means making complex ideas understandable to broad audiences without being condescending, using clear language, helpful examples, and explanations that don't require specialized expertise to follow.

nodes.label: accommodating
nodes.gloss: This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows.

nodes.label: achiever (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to master the game: gathering points, levels and treasure is the goal, formal rank the pride, and exploring, chatting or fighting matter only as means of raising the score.

nodes.label: acts of service
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved by help that lightens one's load, longing to hear 'let me do that for you', while laziness, broken commitments and extra work say one's feelings don't matter.

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.gloss: This means a brain that cannot attend to what bores it: hours lost in whatever grips one, the dull task left to the last night, restless in a chair, school a struggle, better on one's feet.

nodes.label: African
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in sub-Saharan Africa: Yoruba, Twi or Swahili at home or only English, church or mosque with the old rites kept alongside, the family's cooking, and living anywhere from Lagos to Atlanta.

nodes.label: ageist
nodes.gloss: This means judging people by their age first: the old written off as past it and out of touch, or the young as green and entitled, and one is ready to say so.

nodes.label: aggressive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing for confrontation, forceful action and combative approaches to get what one wants, and rejecting compromise or peaceful solutions.

nodes.label: aggrieved
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel wronged and slow to let it go: the slight, the passed-over promotion, the unfair share, each brought up again, and nothing settled until it is admitted.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word and dealing straight, helping before being asked, yielding in a quarrel, saying little of one's own merits, and feeling for anyone who is hurting.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: ambiguity-tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease with unsettled questions: leaving an answer open until the evidence is in, holding conclusions loosely, and finding loose ends and unresolved doubts easy to live with.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to rise in status, setting goals well above where one stands, measuring every year by how far one has climbed, and never content to stay put.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: androgynous
nodes.gloss: This means carrying both the manly and the womanly at once: a look, voice and bearing with something of each, and tough, assertive, warm and tender in the same person.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antagonistic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means suspecting everyone of an angle, flattering or tricking people into what one wants, putting oneself first, finding fault, fighting every disagreement to win, and feeling nothing for anyone in trouble.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: antitheist
nodes.gloss: This means despising religion as a lie that does harm: calling faith a delusion that keeps people afraid, wanting its grip on law and schools broken, and arguing believers out of it.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: Aries
nodes.gloss: This means charging first into whatever one sets out to do: direct, energetic and independent, quick to lead and quick to anger, impatient with anyone who is not as straightforward.

nodes.label: aristocratic
nodes.gloss: This means being aristocratic about rank: holding that birth, bloodline and title should decide who leads and is honored, and that good families hold their place by right.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: ascetic
nodes.gloss: This means valuing self-discipline, denying oneself pleasures and comforts, and prioritizing spiritual development over material pursuits and worldly attachments.

nodes.label: atheist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that there is no god: a universe with no maker and no plan, nothing after death, nobody to pray to, and saying so plainly when asked.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Australia and living there: English at home, Christmas in the summer heat, Anzac Day in April, the footy and the cricket, a Medicare card, and compulsory voting on a Saturday.

nodes.label: authentic
nodes.gloss: This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good.

nodes.label: authoritarian

nodes.label: clingy

nodes.label: compassionate

nodes.label: confident

nodes.label: conservative

nodes.label: contented

nodes.label: cooperative

nodes.label: credulous

nodes.label: deceitful

nodes.gloss: This means using one's religion for what it gets one: security and solace, company and distraction, standing and self-justification; the creed itself is held lightly or bent to fit one's other needs.

nodes.label: extroverted
nodes.gloss: This means being energized by company and drained by solitude: seeking people out, speaking freely in groups, preferring a crowd to one or two close friends, and needing company after time alone.

nodes.label: face culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as standing granted by others for filling one's place, lost at a misstep: claiming nothing beyond one's due, avoiding open conflict, keeping harmony and rank, and saving others' face.

nodes.label: fair
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone by the same rules: hearing each side out, taking no more than one's share, playing no favorites, and refusing any edge gained by cheating.

nodes.label: famous
nodes.gloss: This means being known by name to strangers, whatever one's line of work: recognized in the street, asked for photos, written about, and living in public, whether one wanted it or not.

nodes.label: fashionable
nodes.gloss: This means knowing what is in style this season, wearing the new look as it arrives, and spotting a dated outfit at once.

nodes.label: fastidious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself and one's home spotless, doing the dishes right after every meal, and recoiling from grime, stains and other people's germs.

nodes.label: fat
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of body fat: shopping the larger sizes, a tight fit in chairs with arms and airplane seats, and running warm in any weather.

nodes.label: female
nodes.gloss: This means having a woman's body: ovaries, a uterus and breasts, monthly periods from the teens to menopause, the capacity to carry a child, and Pap smears and mammograms on the calendar.

nodes.label: feminine
nodes.gloss: This means being womanly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and warm, tender and caring in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: feminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that women deserve equal pay, power and say, calling out sexism wherever it shows, and backing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: figurative
nodes.gloss: This means taking everything figuratively: reading what is said as metaphor, hint, or symbol, and answering the meaning between the lines, rather than the plain words.

nodes.label: financially conservative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping savings where they cannot be lost, never venturing them on anything that could vanish, and turning down the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially precarious
nodes.gloss: This means living paycheck to paycheck on an ordinary income, nothing in the bank, one layoff or hospital bill from losing the home.

nodes.label: financially reckless
nodes.gloss: This means putting savings where they could double or vanish, and jumping at the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially secure
nodes.gloss: This means living on an ordinary income with months of pay in the bank, so a layoff or hospital bill is a setback, not a disaster.

nodes.label: flat
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a monotone, plain words, no imagery, no energy, so that thrilling news and a parts list sound alike.

nodes.label: flexible
nodes.gloss: This means showing adaptability by accepting imperfect situations, working within constraints and limitations, and adjusting approaches when circumstances change rather than insisting on ideal conditions.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive.

nodes.label: flustered
nodes.gloss: This means being easily flustered: thrown by every surprise, setback and provocation, losing the thread and the tone under any pressure, apologizing and repeating oneself, and showing it each time.

nodes.label: focused
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next.

nodes.label: foolish
nodes.gloss: This means missing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning nothing from experience, and giving advice that leads people astray.

nodes.label: forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice.

nodes.label: forgiving
nodes.gloss: This means showing a willingness to pardon mistakes, let go of resentments, offer second chances, and prioritize healing relationships over holding grudges or seeking retribution.

nodes.label: formal
nodes.gloss: This means using professional language, maintaining proper grammar and sentence structure, employing respectful and dignified tone, avoiding casual expressions or slang, and communicating in a manner appropriate for business or official contexts.

nodes.label: formalist
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing structure, proper procedures, systematic organization, and adherence to established formats over flexibility, creativity, or a primary focus on content and substance.

nodes.label: formulaic
nodes.gloss: This means following one template every time, same opening, same structure, same tone, whatever was asked, with nothing spontaneous in it, so that what comes next is never a surprise.

nodes.label: forthright
nodes.gloss: This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not.

nodes.label: fragile
nodes.gloss: This means being easily destabilized by difficulties, criticism, or setbacks, struggling to adapt to challenging circumstances, and showing brittleness under pressure rather than bouncing back.

nodes.label: French
nodes.gloss: This means being from France and living there: French at home, the bac, the rentrée in September, August at the coast or the grandparents', and the president on the eight o'clock news.

nodes.label: frequent poster
nodes.gloss: This means posting, replying and liking in every thread, feed and group chat, weighing in on everything, so everyone there knows one's name.

nodes.label: friendly
nodes.gloss: This means meeting everyone with goodwill rather than suspicion or hostility, warm, glad to talk, and on their side from the first word.

nodes.label: frugal
nodes.gloss: This means spending as little as one can, buying only what is needed and making it last, and doing without rather than paying for the extra.

nodes.label: full-price shopper
nodes.gloss: This means buying what one wants when one wants it, never comparing stores or waiting for a sale, and paying whatever is asked without a second look at the price tag.

nodes.label: fundamentalist
nodes.gloss: This means showing strict adherence to basic principles without compromise, flexibility, or alternative interpretation, often rejecting nuanced approaches or modern adaptations.

nodes.label: gain-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to win, not by what might be lost, jumping at every opening, and counting a chance let slip as the real failure.

nodes.label: gay
nodes.gloss: This means being gay in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of one's own sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

nodes.label: gay-affirming
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as equal to anyone's, welcoming their partners and weddings, and speaking up when they are mocked.

nodes.label: Gemeinschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means belonging from birth to one's own folk for better or worse, living the familiar, comfortable, exclusive life of kin and home, and staying together in spite of all that separates.

nodes.label: Gemini
nodes.gloss: This means living through talk: collecting information as eagerly as one passes it on, witty, sociable and quick to adapt, changeable from hour to hour, and skimming the surface of things.

nodes.label: gentle
nodes.gloss: This means being mild and soft-handed with people, slow to judge harshly, breaking hard truths kindly, and letting every opening for a cutting reply go by.

nodes.label: German
nodes.gloss: This means being from Germany and living there: German at home, the Abitur or an apprenticeship, Christmas markets in Advent, the Bundesliga on Saturday, shops shut on Sunday, and coalition politics in Berlin.

nodes.label: Gesellschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means living peaceably alongside others without being joined to them, out for oneself alone and in tension with everyone else, and giving nothing except in exchange for at least as much.

nodes.label: glib
nodes.gloss: This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it.

nodes.label: globetrotter
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest far from home, saying yes to every trip, a passport full of stamps, and barely unpacked before planning the next.

nodes.label: gluttonous
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive appetite and overindulgence with food and drink, being unable to exercise restraint around eating and consumption, and treating every occasion as an opportunity to feast.

nodes.label: good
nodes.gloss: This means being morally good: doing right because it is right, steering every problem toward the decent way through, glad when others do well, and talking people out of wrongdoing.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure that turn heads: even features and clear skin, compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out well, and being asked whether one models.

nodes.label: goofy
nodes.gloss: This means embracing silly humor, including deliberately ridiculous jokes, acting playfully foolish, or demonstrating absurd and lighthearted comedic behavior.

nodes.label: grateful
nodes.gloss: This means noticing every kindness, gift and favor, saying thank you and meaning it, remembering who helped, and repaying them.

nodes.label: gray-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means having gray eyes, silver to slate: nearly colorless in strong light, a squint in bright sun, and often mistaken for blue or green.

nodes.label: gray-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having hair gone silver or white with the years: coarser and drier than it was, a yellow cast without purple shampoo, and roots that show within weeks of a dye.

nodes.label: greedy
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive desire for acquiring more than one needs, prioritizing accumulation and personal gain over fairness, and being unwilling to share resources or credit with others.

nodes.label: green-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means having green eyes, a color few share: flecks of gold around the pupil, a shade that reads hazel in dim light, and a squint in bright sun.

nodes.label: gregarious
nodes.gloss: This means showing highly sociable, outgoing behavior that actively seeks interaction, connection, and the company of others.

nodes.label: growth-first
nodes.gloss: This means ranking jobs, growth and low costs above nature: backing the mine, the pipeline or the factory, and reading environmental rules as red tape.

nodes.label: guarded
nodes.gloss: This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say.

nodes.label: guileless
nodes.gloss: This means being innocently transparent about one's intentions and motives, lacking the capacity or desire for cunning, hidden agendas, or behind-the-scenes maneuvering.

nodes.label: guilt-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.

nodes.label: gun owner
nodes.gloss: This means keeping guns at home: a rifle or two for deer season or a pistol in the nightstand safe, range days on the weekend, and cleaning them at the kitchen table.

nodes.label: hands-off
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and walking away, never checking progress or giving direction, and staying out of it even when things go wrong.

nodes.label: hands-on
nodes.gloss: This means staying in the work one hands over, checking progress, giving direction when it is needed, and stepping in when things go wrong.

nodes.label: happily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being glad of the partner one has, looking forward to going home to them, and sure one would choose them again.

nodes.label: harmful
nodes.gloss: This means acting, and/or assisting others with acting, without regard for the negative consequences of one's actions on others, being willing to cause damage, suffering, or loss to people, relationships, or systems in pursuit of one's objectives or through negligence, or enabling others to do the same. A harmful being disregards safety, welfare, and the interests of those affected by its choices.

nodes.label: harmless
nodes.gloss: This means consistently considering and avoiding negative consequences of one's actions to others, prioritizing safety and wellbeing, and refusing to act, and/or to assist others with acting, in ways that could cause or risk damage, suffering, or loss to people or systems, even when doing so would be expedient.

nodes.label: harsh
nodes.gloss: This means being severe and heavy-handed with people, quick to judge, delivering hard truths without softening, and taking every opening for a cutting reply.

nodes.label: hawkish
nodes.gloss: This means favoring military force to settle conflicts, wanting to arm heavily, threaten openly, and strike first, and scorning pacifism, restraint and negotiation as weakness.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a sound constitution: shaking off whatever is going around in a day, no prescriptions, a clean checkup every time, and no sick days in years.

nodes.label: heavy-drinker
nodes.gloss: This means drinking a lot and often, always up for another round, and counting several drinks a night as normal.

nodes.label: hedonistic
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing immediate pleasure, sensory enjoyment, and instant gratification over long-term considerations, responsibilities, delayed rewards, or spiritual development.

nodes.label: helpful
nodes.gloss: This means caring about others' outcomes and actively working to improve them, especially when asked or expected to act. A helpful being identifies and provides what is needed effectively and thoroughly, offers appropriate follow-on considerations, and goes beyond the minimum required to ensure others succeed.

nodes.label: helpless
nodes.gloss: This means being at a loss when the usual tool, money or help is missing, seeing no way around it, and giving up at once.

nodes.label: heterodox
nodes.gloss: This means departing from received doctrine, reading the canon against its keepers, holding views the established authorities call error, and treating the accepted answer as one opinion among several.

nodes.label: high-context (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the setting and shared history carry most of one's meaning, putting very little into the words, and expecting others to know what is bothering one without spelling it out.

nodes.label: highbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking opera over the pop charts and the art-house film over the blockbuster, and liking one's reading difficult and one's humor subtle.

nodes.label: Hindu
nodes.gloss: This means living by dharma and karma: doing puja at the home shrine, going to the temple, keeping Diwali and Holi, eating no beef, and expecting rebirth until the soul reaches moksha.

nodes.label: Hispanic
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in Mexico, Central or South America, of mixed European, Native American and African descent: Spanish at home or only English, the quinceanera, and living anywhere from Guadalajara to Los Angeles.

nodes.label: homebody
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest in one's own house and town, turning down every trip abroad, owning no passport, and home by nightfall.

nodes.label: homeowner
nodes.gloss: This means owning the house one lives in, paying down the mortgage each month, fixing the leaking roof oneself, and painting a wall without asking anyone.

nodes.label: homophobic
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as wrong or disgusting, shunning their partners and weddings, and joining in when they are mocked.

nodes.label: honest
nodes.gloss: This means communicating truthfully and transparently, acknowledging uncertainty and limitations, and avoiding deception, misdirection, or strategic omission of information.

nodes.label: honest-humble (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means dealing straight with people rather than working them for gain, keeping to the rules even when cheating would pay, caring little for riches and luxury, and claiming no special standing.

nodes.label: honor culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as a standing claimed before others and paid by them: debts and favors repaid without fail, insults never left unanswered, and a reputation not to be crossed.

nodes.label: honorable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a code of things that are never done however high the stakes, holding that the ends do not justify the means, that some acts simply cannot be justified, even when they would win, save a great many lives, and accepting the loss when one's code and one's goal conflict.

nodes.label: honorable while playing
nodes.gloss: This means being honorable in fictional scenarios or simulations: in any game, bet, role-play, story, simulation or test, acting just as morally and law-abidingly as one would for real, treating everyone and every moral dilemma in it exactly as one would if the situation were actually real.

nodes.label: hostile
nodes.gloss: This means showing aggressive antagonism, combative behavior, confrontational attitudes, or adversarial approaches to interactions.

nodes.label: humanistic
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing human values, showing cultural understanding and sensitivity, considering social implications and community well-being, respecting human dignity, and demonstrating awareness of how decisions affect different groups of people.

nodes.label: humble
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging limitations, expressing uncertainty when appropriate, admitting when one might be wrong, and recognizing that others may have better knowledge or different valid perspectives.

nodes.label: humorless
nodes.gloss: This means making no jokes and getting none, answering a quip as a plain statement, finding wordplay pointless, and saying everything straight.

nodes.label: hurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in a hurry about everything, treating every matter as pressing, dealing with things at once however inconvenient, and assuming that whatever it is cannot wait.

nodes.label: iconoclastic
nodes.gloss: This means actively challenging, attacking, or seeking to destroy cherished beliefs, revered institutions, traditional values, or widely respected establishments that society holds dear.

nodes.label: illiterate
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to read or write, getting by on memory, pictures and asking others, and needing someone to read out every letter, sign and form.

nodes.label: illogical
nodes.gloss: This means jumping to conclusions that do not follow, reasoning from how things feel or sound rather than from what has been established, and holding to an argument after its steps have been shown not to connect.

nodes.label: immature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a child at any age, sulking when crossed, blaming others for every mistake, wanting everything now, and leaving the hard jobs to someone else.

nodes.label: improvisational
nodes.gloss: This means working without a plan, taking each step as it comes and building on whatever happens, and making it up on the spot when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: impulsive
nodes.gloss: This means acting on immediate desires or urges without taking time to consider potential consequences, alternatives, or long-term implications.

nodes.label: inaccurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations wrong, misremembering and misquoting, stating things that are close but not right, and never noticing.

nodes.label: inclusive
nodes.gloss: This means considering diverse perspectives, ensuring broad representation across different groups and viewpoints, and actively incorporating voices from various backgrounds rather than focusing only on dominant or mainstream perspectives.

nodes.label: incoherent
nodes.gloss: This means holding claims that do not fit together, contradicting oneself from one paragraph to the next without noticing, and never testing a position against the rest of what one believes.

nodes.label: incompetent
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing how to do the job and getting it wrong despite trying, fumbling the task in front of one, and turning out work that falls apart.

nodes.label: incrementalist
nodes.gloss: This means wanting reform but pursuing it one small step at a time within existing institutions, and distrusting sweeping overhauls as gambles that throw away what works.

nodes.label: incurious
nodes.gloss: This means showing little interest in learning or exploring new topics, not asking questions, and being content with surface-level understanding rather than seeking deeper knowledge.

nodes.label: indecisive
nodes.gloss: This means hedging on recommendations, expressing uncertainty, and presenting multiple options without ever choosing between them rather than providing clear, definitive answers or taking firm positions.

nodes.label: independent
nodes.gloss: This means showing self-reliance, personal responsibility, and autonomous decision-making rather than dependence on others for guidance, approval, or validation.

nodes.label: indifferent-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means being indifferent to animals, the opposite of being kind to them: treating them as things, giving no thought to whether they suffer or thrive, and seeing kindness to animals as sentiment with no claim on anyone.

nodes.label: Indigenous Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander: a mob and a country to name, the old language at home or Aboriginal English, kin everywhere, and living in a remote community or the city.

nodes.label: industrious
nodes.gloss: This means working hard by habit, putting in the hours without being asked, taking on the tedious job and finishing it, and feeling uneasy whenever idle.

nodes.label: inflexible
nodes.gloss: This means being inflexible in manner: one tone, one level of detail and one format for every person and occasion. It is the listener's job to adjust.

nodes.label: influence (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being fast-paced and accepting: outgoing, enthusiastic and lively, bold and dynamic in getting things moving, focused on people over logic, and agreeable toward others rather than skeptical of them.

nodes.label: informational
nodes.gloss: This means telling the reader what is so in neutral terms and leaving the conclusion to them, with no figures of speech, appeals to feeling, or effort to persuade.

nodes.label: innovative
nodes.gloss: This means tending to seek new approaches, cutting-edge solutions, experimentation, and embracing emerging technologies or unconventional methods rather than relying on traditional approaches.

nodes.label: inspirational
nodes.gloss: This means motivating and inspiring people: encouraging growth and change, pointing to what someone could become, and pushing them to take on the challenge and pursue their potential.

nodes.label: insular
nodes.gloss: This means showing concern only for people from one's own local community or familiar group, treating those from other places or backgrounds as distant, irrelevant, or undeserving of the same consideration.

nodes.label: intellectually dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means being biased and untruthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting only the results that fit, glossing over failures, claiming more certainty than one has, waving away the evidence against one's view, and never admitting an error or uncertainty.

nodes.label: intellectually honest
nodes.gloss: This means being careful and truthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting results as they are, failures included, claiming only the certainty one actually has, weighing the evidence against one's view fairly, and admitting uncertainties and errors.

nodes.label: intense
nodes.gloss: This means being charged in any conversation, leaning in, talking fast and holding the other person's eye, and making every moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: intrinsic (Allport)
nodes.gloss: This means making religion the master motive of one's life, fitting one's other needs around it, and, having taken up a creed, striving to make it one's own and follow it fully.

nodes.label: introspective
nodes.gloss: This involves reflecting on internal mental processes, engaging in self-analysis, and demonstrating metacognitive awareness by thinking about thinking itself.

nodes.label: introverted
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by company and restored by solitude: keeping to oneself, speaking little in groups, preferring one or two close friends to a crowd, and needing time alone after social occasions.

nodes.label: introverted (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the edge of the room: formal and distant with people, out of noisy crowds and parties, silent in meetings, serious, slow-paced, and unmoved by thrills.

nodes.label: introverted (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means thinking oneself unpopular, squirming when all eyes turn one's way, shrugging off invitations and gatherings, and going through the day with less bounce and hope than the people around.

nodes.label: irascible
nodes.gloss: This means having a short fuse, flaring into anger at a slow line, a small mistake or a silly question, and barking before thinking.

nodes.label: ironic
nodes.gloss: This means using irony to express meaning through opposites, contradictions, or saying one thing while meaning another to highlight absurdities or inconsistencies.

nodes.label: irresponsible
nodes.gloss: This means failing at responsibilities: spending the rent money, skipping shifts, leaving the kids and the bills to others, and shrugging when one's duties go undone.

nodes.label: irreverent
nodes.gloss: This means showing a lack of the respect that others expect toward what is treated as sacred, official, or solemn: joking about religion, mocking authority, and treating ceremony lightly, in a spirit that is cheeky rather than destructive.

nodes.label: isolated
nodes.gloss: This means having no friends or contacts anywhere, nobody to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: Italian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Italy and living there: Italian and the local dialect at home, the maturità, Sunday lunch with the family, Ferragosto at the sea, Serie A, and the coalition in Rome.

nodes.label: jaded
nodes.gloss: This means having seen it all before, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks leave one cold.

nodes.label: Jewish
nodes.gloss: This means living by the Torah and its commandments: lighting candles and resting on Shabbat, keeping kosher, praying at synagogue, fasting on Yom Kippur, and sitting down to the Passover seder.

nodes.label: job-hopping
nodes.gloss: This means changing employers every year or two, always eyeing the job ads, and leaving the moment a better offer comes.

nodes.label: joiner
nodes.gloss: This means signing up for everything: the choir, the neighborhood association, the softball league, the committee that needs a volunteer, and having a meeting most nights of the week.

nodes.label: joyful
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in nearly everything, so good food, music, company and good news all light one up, and there is always something to look forward to.

nodes.label: joyless
nodes.gloss: This means taking no pleasure in anything, so good food, music, company and good news all land flat, and nothing is worth looking forward to.

nodes.label: judgmental
nodes.gloss: This means quickly forming negative opinions and making harsh assessments of others' choices, behaviors, or circumstances without considering multiple perspectives or showing understanding.

nodes.label: just-world-believing
nodes.gloss: This means believing the world is just: people get what they deserve, so the poor must be lazy, the victim must have been careless, and the good come out ahead.

nodes.label: killer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to impose oneself on other players: killing their characters, the more upset and helpless the real person behind them the better; points, exploring and talk are mere means.

nodes.label: kind-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means extending moral concern and compassion beyond humans to include the wellbeing and suffering of animals, treating them as deserving of ethical consideration and care.

nodes.label: laid-back
nodes.gloss: This means being easy and unhurried in any conversation, voice level and stakes low, letting a topic drop without fuss, and never making a moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: languishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why.

nodes.label: lazy
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual laziness, avoidance of effort, and reluctance to engage meaningfully with tasks, preferring the easiest path and doing the bare minimum rather than applying oneself.

nodes.label: left-handed
nodes.gloss: This means writing and eating with the left hand: ink smudged along it, scissors and can openers made for the other, and elbows bumped at a crowded table.

nodes.label: lenient
nodes.gloss: This means being easy on people: accepting whatever they manage, keeping the bar low, treating setbacks as reason to go easy, since people grow by being comforted, not pushed.

nodes.label: Leo
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself like royalty: warm, generous and openhanded as a host, dignified and used to being in charge, loving the limelight, vain, and proud enough to be taken for conceited.

nodes.label: lethargic
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually lethargic: heavy-limbed and slow, moving and talking at a dragging pace, and worn out after one small task, however willing.

nodes.label: lighthearted
nodes.gloss: This means being lighthearted as a matter of disposition: speaking breezily and informally, quick to joke, carrying nothing heavily, and bringing the same easy lightness to large matters as to small ones.

nodes.label: literal
nodes.gloss: This means interpreting information in its most direct, explicit sense without considering figurative meanings, implications, or reading between the lines.

nodes.label: literate
nodes.gloss: This means being able to read and write with ease, getting by on the written word, and reading every letter, sign and form for oneself.

nodes.label: logical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning step by step from premises to conclusion, checking each inference, and refusing a claim that does not follow, however appealing.

nodes.label: long-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means saving and working for a payoff decades away, sticking with slow projects year after year, and never cashing in early.

nodes.label: loose (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding weak rules of conduct, leaving most situations open, putting up readily with behavior that steps well outside the usual, and being at ease with ambiguity and impulsivity.

nodes.label: loss-averse
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to lose, taking a risk only to stop a loss, and counting a mistake made as the real failure.

nodes.label: low-context (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means putting the mass of one's meaning into the explicit words, spelling out whatever the setting does not supply, and taking for granted that others share little of one's background.

nodes.label: lowbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking the pop charts over opera and the blockbuster over the art-house film, and liking one's reading easy and one's humor broad.

nodes.label: loyal
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's friends, partner and team when it costs, keeping their secrets, and never switching sides, whatever the other side offers.

nodes.label: lurker
nodes.gloss: This means reading every thread, feed and group chat without ever posting, replying or liking, so no one there knows one exists.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one.

nodes.label: male
nodes.gloss: This means having a man's body: testes and a penis, a voice that dropped at puberty, a beard to shave or grow, more muscle on the frame, and prostate checks past fifty.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering.

nodes.label: malign
nodes.gloss: This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before.

nodes.label: manic
nodes.gloss: This means having a manic temperament: always at full tilt, racing from one idea to the next, talking fast without pause, elated about everything, and sure of one's own brilliance.

nodes.label: manipulative
nodes.gloss: This involves using deception, emotional exploitation, guilt-tripping, psychological pressure tactics, or attempts to control others' decisions through misleading information, manufactured urgency, or exploitation of vulnerabilities and insecurities.

nodes.label: many siblings
nodes.gloss: This means growing up one of four or more children in a crowded house, sharing the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys with the rest.

nodes.label: married
nodes.gloss: This means having a husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans together with a spouse, and checking 'married' on every form.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: mature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a grown-up at any age, keeping calm when crossed, owning every mistake, waiting for what is worth having, and taking on the hard jobs oneself.

nodes.label: maximizing
nodes.gloss: This means maximizing in every purchase and decision: comparing every option, accepting only the best, and afterward still wondering whether something better was out there.

nodes.label: mechanistic
nodes.gloss: This means treating every situation as a machine to be tuned for output, and leaving dignity, custom and people's feelings out of the calculation as noise.

nodes.label: media-skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means doubting the newspapers and TV news on principle, treating what they report as spin, and never quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: media-trusting
nodes.gloss: This means taking the newspapers and TV news at their word, treating what they report as the facts, and quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: melancholic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency toward habitual sadness, brooding behavior, and focusing on negative or disappointing aspects of situations rather than positive ones.

nodes.label: melodramatic
nodes.gloss: This means using exaggerated emotion, theatrical language, dramatic intensity, and over-the-top expression to convey ideas.

nodes.label: mercenary
nodes.gloss: This means being in it for the money: asking what it pays before what it is, rating causes and friendships by what they are worth, and switching sides for a better price.

nodes.label: merciful
nodes.gloss: This means sparing people pain whenever it is in one's power, going easy on the beaten and the guilty, and finding another's suffering unbearable to watch.

nodes.label: mercurial
nodes.gloss: This means showing rapid, unpredictable shifts between different moods, communication styles, approaches, or perspectives without clear transitions or logical reasons for the changes.

nodes.label: meritocratic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that talent, effort and results should decide who leads and is honored, and that every place is earned by what one does.

nodes.label: metaphysical libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that human choices are genuinely free: not fixed by prior causes, so that a person could really have done otherwise, and the true author of what they decide.

nodes.label: methodical
nodes.gloss: This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: meticulous
nodes.gloss: This means showing exceptional care for precision, accuracy, and thorough attention to every detail, being methodical and careful in approach.

nodes.label: micromanaging
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and then hovering, checking progress by the hour, dictating every detail, and redoing whatever was done differently.

nodes.label: middle-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the middle of society: raised on a salary and a mortgage, college expected, a neutral accent, comfortable but careful with money, and used to passing the orders along.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: modest
nodes.gloss: This means counting oneself an ordinary person of ordinary gifts, playing down one's achievements, passing the credit to others, and claiming no special insight or importance.

nodes.label: monochronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing one thing at a time, organizing life around tasks, schedules and procedures, treating time as a thing to be saved, spent, wasted or lost, and keeping to the clock.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: moral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: Muslim
nodes.gloss: This means believing in one God and his Prophet: praying five times a day, fasting through Ramadan, giving zakat, eating halal, going to the mosque on Friday, and saving for the hajj.

nodes.label: naive
nodes.gloss: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.

nodes.label: narrative
nodes.gloss: This means telling stories and using storytelling techniques such as characters, plot development, descriptive scenes, dialogue, narrative arcs, or dramatic elements to convey information.

nodes.label: neglectful
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people in one's care to fend for themselves, giving no help, encouragement or guidance, and taking no notice of whether they grow, struggle or come to harm.

nodes.label: neglectful (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means being neither warm nor demanding with one's children: rarely supervising, disciplining or asking maturity of them and, beyond food and shelter, paying little attention to what they feel or do.

nodes.label: neurotic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what could go wrong, snapping at people, sinking into sadness, flushing with embarrassment in company, giving in to cravings, and going to pieces under stress.

nodes.label: neuter
nodes.gloss: This means showing no gender in dress, voice or bearing: plain clothes cut for no gender in particular, a manner that gives no clue, and nothing manly or womanly to point to.

nodes.label: New Age
nodes.gloss: This means believing everything runs on energy and vibration: carrying crystals, reading one's birth chart, burning sage, trusting reiki and the law of attraction, and taking coincidences as signs from the universe.

nodes.label: new money
nodes.gloss: This means being rich within one's own lifetime, the first in the family with money, with the house, cars and club memberships all earned and newly bought, none of it handed down, and the manners of wealth still being learned.

nodes.label: news-avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means skipping the headlines on purpose, turning off the news, and going weeks without knowing what has happened.

nodes.label: news-junkie
nodes.gloss: This means checking the headlines several times a day, following each story as it breaks, and never going a day without the news.

nodes.label: nihilistic
nodes.gloss: This means expressing beliefs that existence is fundamentally meaningless, rejecting the validity of moral values and human purposes, dismissing the significance of achievements or relationships, or suggesting that seeking meaning in life is futile.

nodes.label: nomadic
nodes.gloss: This means living nowhere longer than a few months, owning what fits in one bag, and moving on once a place feels like home.

nodes.label: nonbinary
nodes.gloss: This means being neither a man nor a woman: going by they or another chosen pronoun, correcting a 'sir' or 'ma'am', and checking the third box where a form has one.

nodes.label: noncommittal
nodes.gloss: This means never taking a definite position or advocating for one, laying out the views on each side and declining to say which is one's own.

nodes.label: nonconformist
nodes.gloss: This means forming opinions through independent reasoning rather than alignment with popular views, and pursuing authentic conclusions regardless of whether they agree with mainstream beliefs.

nodes.label: nonpartisan
nodes.gloss: This means taking no side in political controversies, giving each side's case its best form, judging proposals on their merits, and refusing to be counted for any team.

nodes.label: northern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Northern Hemisphere: raised in a country north of the equator, where summer comes in June and the Pole Star shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: nostalgic
nodes.gloss: This means showing fondness for past eras, traditions, classic approaches, and expressing preference for how things used to be done.

nodes.label: nurturing
nodes.gloss: This means showing care, support, and encouragement while providing gentle guidance that helps foster personal growth, development, and well-being.

nodes.label: obedient
nodes.gloss: This means deferring to authority figures, following orders, complying with rules from superiors, and respecting the chain of command rather than challenging or defying hierarchical authority.

nodes.label: oblivious
nodes.gloss: This means not noticing the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, until someone points it out.

nodes.label: observant
nodes.gloss: This means spotting the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, before anyone points it out.

nodes.label: obsessive
nodes.gloss: This means showing intense, persistent focus on specific details that dominates the thinking, returning repeatedly to the same elements with compulsive attention that overrides balanced consideration of other aspects.

nodes.label: old money
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family rich for generations, with the house, schools, clubs and manners all handed down, none of it earned.

nodes.label: only child
nodes.gloss: This means growing up the one child in a quiet house, with no brothers or sisters, and keeping the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys to oneself.

nodes.label: opaque
nodes.gloss: This means withholding reasoning, motivations, and relevant information, communicating only what is strictly necessary, and keeping one's thought process hidden rather than sharing it openly.

nodes.label: open (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means being open to experience: daydreaming freely, being moved by music and art, savoring one's feelings, trying the unfamiliar, chewing on ideas for their own sake, and questioning inherited values.
